streams.intro: The longer story behind some of the work.

site.about:
I grew up on a coast that changed shape every winter, and I have been drawing maps of it ever since.

I work in pencil and ink, then print by risograph or screen. Clients include publishers, small museums and one very patient ferry company.

data.title: The Harbour Atlas
data.summary: Twelve hand-drawn charts of an imaginary coast, printed as a folding atlas.
data.body:
A year of drawing one coast, a bay at a time.

## How it was made

Pencil first, then ink on drafting film, then two-colour risograph.

> Every map is a decision about what to leave out.
